about: Neon Atlas keyword opportunity database. No search volumes are recorded because none were measured. Demand and competition are labelled levels with their basis. Replace 'estimate' with 'measured' only when a figure comes from Search Console, Google Trends or a keyword tool, and record the source in 'notes'.

measuredSignals.signal: Searches for 'GTA' and 'GTA VI' reached their highest level since the June 2026 pre-order period, per a Benzinga article citing Google Trends (relative interest, not volume).
Google's 2025 Year in Search: coverage reports 'Grand Theft Auto 6' at 7th in one games list and 9th in another, behind ARC Raiders and Battlefield 6 (relative ranking, not volume).
